recommended_dataset.universe: approximately 50 point-in-time liquid Spot USDT pairs per month
recommended_dataset.parse_time: approximately 2-10 minutes on local development hardware
recommended_dataset.incremental_monthly_cost: about 50 files, 37,200 rows, 1.8 MB compressed at the stated sample-derived 35 KB/file assumption

optional_direct_archives.4h: about 840,000 rows; avoid by deterministic resampling from canonical 1h
optional_direct_archives.1d: about 135,000 rows; avoid by deterministic resampling from canonical 1h
optional_direct_archives.aggTrades_or_trades: not estimated as a required first-pass input; potentially orders of magnitude larger and unsuitable for this low-cost first pass

storage_choice: SQLite is installed and adequate for metadata/audit; Parquet or DuckDB would be preferable for a future analytical dataset but neither should be added in P2. VPS and local development are suitable for the recommended scale.
